event_name: Rich Energy Haas F1 Team Document 38 Date 09 June 2019 Time 12:31 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 36), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 3rd Control Electronics (CE) has been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance to with Article 23.3 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the Pit Lane for a prior infringement (document 32).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
